summary: Backend-only re-validation of the iteration_19 CRITICAL TOCTOU race in POST /api/invoices. RESULT: the atomic-claim fix WORKS. (1) Concurrency probe (tests/test_invoice_concurrent_race.py, extended): 5 truly parallel identical POSTs with the same purchase_ids returned [409,409,200,409,409] -> exactly ONE invoice doc in Mongo, both purchases linked to that single invoice, GET /api/admin/clients/{cid}/purchase-integrity => is_healthy=true, cross_invoice_conflicts=[], orphans_in_invoice=[], purchase_ids_not_found=[]. Added a second burst test: after a successful invoice, 4 more concurrent identical submits return [409,409,409,409], no extra invoice, purchases keep the winner's invoice_id, integrity healthy. (2) Rollback branch verified DETERMINISTICALLY (new tests/test_invoice_atomic_claim.py): setting one purchase's invoice_id to a falsy-but-unmatched value (0) lets the python pre-check pass but blocks the conditional update_many -> 409 'Otra factura reclamo estas compras al mismo tiempo', the just-inserted invoice document is deleted (invoice count unchanged) and the partially claimed purchase is released back to invoice_id=None; the released purchases are still invoiceable afterwards (happy path 200 + integrity healthy). (3) Soft-delete guard: POST /api/invoices with is_deleted=true purchase -> 409 '1 compra(s) estan eliminadas y no pueden facturarse: <item>', no invoice created, purchase untouched. (4) Pre-check regression: stale submit of already-invoiced ids -> 409 '2 compra(s) ya estan facturadas: ... Refresca la pagina', no new invoice, purchases still point at the original invoice, integrity healthy. (5) Happy path all-pending -> 200 with purchases linked. (6) purchase-integrity still detects all 3 injected corruption classes and reports healthy for clean clients / C5557 (4 invoices, 20 purchases). (7) Guard regressions untouched: add-items cross-invoice 400 'ya esta en otra factura', add-items pending 200, annul frees invoice_id and allows re-invoice, restore blocked with 409 're-facturados' when purchases were re-billed, restore without password 400. SCORES: tests/test_invoice_double_submit_guard.py 18/18 PASS (was 17/18), tests/test_invoice_concurrent_race.py 2/2 PASS (was 0/1), tests/test_invoice_atomic_claim.py 4/5 PASS. Full suite: 327 passed / 18 failed / 6 skipped -> the 17 failures are the exact pre-existing set from iteration_18/19 (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing, employees/audit RBAC, clients-debts KeyError 'available', stale legacy expectations) plus my 1 NEW finding below. No new 500s or tracebacks attributable to create_invoice in backend logs.

minor.issue: DUPLICATE invoice_number under concurrency (NEW, previously masked by the TOCTOU bug). invoice_number is built from `count_documents({customer_id}) + 1`, which is itself a read-then-write race. 4 concurrent POSTs with DISJOINT purchase_ids for the same customer all returned 200 and produced invoice_numbers ['T8722-001','T8722-002','T8722-002','T8722-004','T8722-004'] - two duplicated numbers and a gap at -003. Purchases/integrity stay healthy (is_healthy=true), so this is a numbering/UX + accounting-traceability defect, not data corruption. Fix: use an atomic per-customer counter (findOneAndUpdate with $inc on a counters collection) or a unique index on (tenant_id, invoice_number) + retry loop. Repro: tests/test_invoice_atomic_claim.py::TestConcurrentDistinctInvoices::test_invoice_numbers_unique_under_concurrency

The rollback branch is not perfectly fair: if two concurrent requests each win a DIFFERENT subset of the purchases, BOTH roll back and the user gets 409 with zero invoices created (livelock). Not observed in 9 parallel submits across two bursts (always exactly 1 winner), but with more purchases per invoice it becomes likely. Consider claiming purchases BEFORE inserting the invoice, or retrying once server-side after a mismatch.

The purchases query at ~5947 still does not filter {'is_deleted': {'$ne': True}} - the guard rejects with 409 which is correct behaviour, but the equally valid alternative (silently excluding deleted items) is not applied; also the atomic claim filter does not exclude is_deleted, so a purchase soft-deleted between the pre-check and the claim would still be claimed.

Still open from iteration_19: missing Authorization header returns 422 instead of 401; orphans_in_invoice spreads the whole purchase document (**p) into the response payload; no auto-repair action offered.

action_items: Fix duplicate invoice_number under concurrency: replace count_documents()+1 with an atomic $inc counter (or unique index on tenant_id+invoice_number with retry). Currently two invoices for the same client can share a number and the sequence has gaps.

Optional hardening: claim purchases BEFORE inserting the invoice document (or retry once on modified_count mismatch) so partial-claim collisions cannot end with zero invoices created for both requests.
Optional: add {'is_deleted': {'$ne': True}} to the create_invoice purchases query and to the atomic claim filter for defence in depth.

Pre-existing / still open (NOT this iteration): EMERGENT_LLM_KEY not configured -> all OCR/upload endpoints 500 (29 tracebacks in backend.err.log); employees/audit-logs RBAC hole; /api/admin/clients-debts KeyError 'available' (9 tracebacks); tenant-isolation test failures in test_multi_tenant_saas.py.
critical_code_review_comments: create_invoice: the atomic claim (update_many filtered on invoice_id null/missing/'' + modified_count check + rollback of claimed purchases and delete of the inserted invoice) is correct and closes the reported TOCTOU race - verified end to end, including the rollback branch.
invoice_number is still generated with a non-atomic count_documents()+1 inside the same handler - the last remaining read-then-write race in create_invoice.
The rollback uses two separate awaits without a transaction; if the process dies between them an orphan invoice or a stuck claim can remain. Low probability but worth a note/repair script.
server.py is ~9700 lines - still needs to be split into routers (invoices, wallet, admin, shipments) per the 700-line guideline.

rca_of_the_issue: Original TOCTOU: the pre-check (read purchases, reject if any invoice_id) and the purchases.update_many were separate non-atomic steps, and the invoice was inserted before the purchases were claimed, so two concurrent submits both passed the check and both wrote an invoice (iteration_19 reproduced [200,409,409,200,409] with cross_invoice_conflicts=2). The fix moves the correctness guarantee into the update filter itself ($or invoice_id null/missing/'') and verifies modified_count == len(purchase_ids); on mismatch it releases the purchases it claimed and deletes its own invoice doc, returning 409. Verified: single winner, no orphans, no cross-invoice conflicts, rollback leaves no invoice behind and releases purchases. Residual race: invoice_number is still derived from count_documents()+1, so concurrent creations of different invoices for the same customer can mint identical numbers (reproduced: two duplicated numbers out of 5).
